uutiset.t: Where did it go wrong for Slegers at Arsenal?
uutiset.s: Arsenal have parted company with Renee Slegers after less than two years permanently in charge, during which time the club celebrated unrivalled highs and endured dispiriting lows. The polarisation of the Dutchwoman's tenure is quite unusual.
